notes_for_editor: Dates are approximate across sources (1930, c.1930, 1930 +/-). The brief's kind 'ground' is not stated in any source read; sources say 'L-4 cab atop north point' and do not describe a tower, so the brief value was left unchanged. The Idaho Fire Lookouts page says it has no documented staffing history, so staffing is omitted. The firelookout.com page is titled 'Moccasin Point Fire Lookout Cabin'. Access level is not stated in any source, so access is omitted. The Forest Service list says highlighted lookouts remain in existence today; text extraction does not show highlighting, so Moccasin Point's highlight status was not checked and today's status is not stated. A PDF check of highlighting in source 4 would settle this.
